title: (Junior) Grafikdesigner E-Commerce (m/w/d)
description: Unter der Marke MAMEIDO designen und vertreiben wir Lifestyle-Produkte aus den Kategorien Drink & Food to-go sowie Home. Produkt-Content für Marktplätze: Du erstellst Produktbilder, Infografiken und A+ Content für unsere Listings und passt sie für unsere internationalen Verkaufsmärkte an. Von der Vorlage bis zur druckfertigen Datei. Außerdem entwickelst du Verpackungen, Labels und Einleger weiter. Wirkung im Blick: Du schaust dir an, welche Bildvarianten konvertieren und wo Darstellungen zu Retouren führen – und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab. Tagesgeschäft: Du übernimmst Anpassungen bei Produktänderungen, Korrekturen, Retuschen und kurzfristige Design-Tasks aus dem Team. Wie wir arbeiten : Die Ideen kommen meist aus dem Team – aus Produktmanagement, Marketing oder von uns. Wir wissen aus Rezensionen, Retourengründen und Marktdaten sehr genau, was ein Produktbild leisten muss, und bei Artworks arbeiten wir mit Moodboards und klaren Vorstellungen. Deine Stärke ist es, diese Ideen in etwas zu übersetzen, das funktioniert und gut aussieht. Wenn du eigene Vorschläge einbringen willst: sehr gern, unsere Tür steht offen. Muss aber nicht. Perspektivisch : Wenn der Produkt-Content über alle Kanäle steht, kann sich die Rolle in Richtung Marketing-Design erweitern – Kampagnen, Social, Ad-Creatives. Das kommt aber später und hängt davon ab, wohin du dich entwickeln willst. Qualifikation Du hast eine gestalterische Ausbildung, ein Studium – oder ein Portfolio, das für sich spricht? Dann passt du zu uns, wenn du Folgendes mitbringst: Erste Erfahrung im Grafikdesign, in der Mediengestaltung oder im digitalen Content Ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie und Bildkomposition, auch innerhalb eines bestehenden Corporate Designs Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Design-Tools wie Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) Ein offenes Mindset gegenüber KI-Tools und ihren Möglichkeiten im Design – du probierst Neues aus, bevor es Standard ist, und suchst den effizienteren Weg statt den gewohnten Grundverständnis für Druckvorstufe und Farbmanagement – oder die Bereitschaft, dich schnell einzuarbeiten Die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte parallel zu steuern, Deadlines zu halten und mit wechselnden Prioritäten umzugehen Sorgfalt und Ausdauer: Ein erheblicher Teil der Arbeit ist Serienproduktion in gleichbleibender Qualität Eine selbstständige, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse – weitere Sprachen wie Französisch, Italienisch oder Spanisch sind ein Plus Erfahrung mit Amazon-Content oder E-Commerce ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung – das bringen wir dir bei. Benefits Einstieg mit Perspektive: Klare Perspektive auf Gehaltssteigerung bei entsprechender Performance 50 € netto extra im Monat: Steuerfreier Sachbezug als Guthabenkarte, frei einsetzbar – zusätzlich zum Gehalt Deine Arbeit wird Produkt: Deine Entwürfe landen auf Dingen, die Menschen jeden Tag in der Hand halten – nicht nur auf Bildschirmen Kurze Wege: Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen. Was du morgens gestaltest, kann übermorgen live sein Flexibles Arbeiten: 3 bis 4 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche nach Absprache, ansonsten gemeinsam im Büro in Düsseldorf Moderne Ausstattung: Attraktives Büro, Apple Produkte und Adobe Creative Cloud Weiterbildung: Unterstützung bei individuellen, jobbezogenen Weiterbildungen JobRad Du erkennst dich wieder, aber nicht in jedem Punkt? Du bist sicher im Stakeholder Management und kannst unterschiedliche technische und wirtschaftliche Anforderungen gegeneinander abwägen und priorisieren. Mehrere parallele Workstreams und wechselnde Prioritäten bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept – du behältst den Überblick und setzt klare Schwerpunkte. Du arbeitest gerne kollaborativ und standortübergreifend mit Kollegen in Hamburg und Naarden zusammen. Du interessierst dich für AI Tools und digitale Lösungen und probierst gerne neue Wege aus, um Prozesse und Workflows effizienter zu gestalten. Erfahrung in Logistik, Parcel oder Freight Tech, insbesondere mit Carrier-API-Integrationen, ist ein Plus. Kenntnisse rund um HubSpot bzw. CRM-Integrationen oder Finanz- und Invoicing Systeme sind ebenfalls von Vorteil. Warum ITA Logistics Group? Bei uns erwartet dich ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind und Feedback nicht nur erlaubt, sondern erwünscht ist. raw.title: Software Engineer, Platform - Frankfurt, Germany
raw.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust APIs including public TTS API, internal APIs like Payment, Subscription, Auth and Consumption Tracking, ensuring they meet business and scalability requirements
  • Oversee the full backend API landscape, enhancing and optimizing for performance and maintainability
  • Collaborate on B2B solutions, focusing on customization and integration needs for enterprise clients
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to align backend architecture with overall product strategy and user experience

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Proven experience in backend development: TS/Node (required)
  • Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers
  • Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
  • Preferred: Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
  • Preferred: Proficiency in deploying high availability applications on Kubernetes

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Germany Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-120,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Refer them!

  • Du verfügst mindestens über einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Medizininformatik, eHealth oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von Gesundheitstechnologien sowie in der Steuerung komplexer Schnittstellen- und Datenintegrationsprojekte im klinischen Umfeld
  • Du besitzt praktische Erfahrung mit klinischen Prozessen, IT-Architekturen und Systemen wie HIS, RIS, PACS und ERP sowie mit Standards wie HL7 v2, HL7 FHIR, DICOM und idealerweise openEHR
  • Du hast idealerweise Vorerfahrung als Solution Consultant oder im technischen Presales, kannst Anforderungen technisch lesen und kommunizierst mit Architekt:innen und Entwickler:innen auf Augenhöhe
  • Du bringst die Flexibilität mit, in wechselnden Rollen und Projektkontexten zu arbeiten, und stellst Dich schnell auf neue Kunden, Themen und Technologien ein
  • Du bist bereit, für Kundeneinsätze projektabhängig zu reisen – überwiegend im deutschsprachigen Raum
  • Du arbeitest routiniert cross-funktional mit anderen Fachbereichen
  • Du kommunizierst präzise, freundlich und serviceorientiert und überzeugst durch eine hohe Kundenorientierung
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, lösungs- und geschäftsorientiert und verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Selbstorganisation

title: (Senior) Collection Merchandiser Shoes (f/m/d)
description: What you will do: As the (Senior) Collection Merchandiser for the Shoes category, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of the footwear assortment. This role requires a deep understanding of luxury fashion, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to drive innovation while maintaining the brand's identity. You will work closely with the design, product development, sales, marketing, and operations teams to create a cohesive and successful shoe collection that meets the needs of both direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business-to-business (B2B) channels. Assortment Strategy: Develop and implement a long-term assortment strategy for the Shoes category, aligning with the brands product vision and catering to the unique requirements of D2C and B2B channels. Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and consumer insights to inform strategic decision-making. Collection Creation: Lead the seasonal collection creation process for Shoes, working in close partnership with the design and product development teams. Ensure the collection reflects the brand's DNA, resonates with target customers, and meets commercial objectives. Own the range and the line plan and ensure they are constantly updated. Critical Path Management: Own the critical path for the Shoes category, ensuring all key milestones and deadlines are met. Schedule and coordinate all relevant meetings, ensuring appropriate stakeholders are involved and prepared. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns and product stories that enhance the visibility and desirability of the Shoes category. Work with sales teams to gather feedback from wholesale partners and clients, ensuring their needs are reflected in the assortment. Foster strong communication and collaboration across departments to achieve common goals. Partner with operations to ensure smooth product delivery and availability across all channels. Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyze the performance of the Shoes category, identifying opportunities for growth and areas for improvement. What you will bring: Proven experience (4-5 years) in a merchandising or product management role within the luxury fashion industry, ideally with a focus on footwear. Strong understanding of the luxury market, including D2C and B2B dynamics. Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and meet tight deadlines. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across departments. Passion for luxury fashion, design, and craftsmanship. What we offer: A bright and spacious design office in the heart of Berlin embodying our brand values and focusing on employee well-being. A unique chance to shape our company’s future and build a global brand, all within a motivating, international work environment with employees of 14+ nationalities. A high level of responsibility, creative freedom, and the opportunity to bring your originality, ideas, and independence to life. Once-per-season gift voucher, to be used on Aeyde footwear and accessories. Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership, Berlin Public Transport pass or German lessons for international employees. 30 days of holidays. Flexible hybrid working model subject to team specifications. Regular team events include our Christmas and Summer Party as well as extraordinary monthly team lunches. Relocation assistance available including visa support. title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) KI & Automatisierung Stuttgart
description: Wir suchen Bei HWS verbinden wir Wirtschaftsprüfung und Steuerberatung mit dem Anspruch, mittelständische Unternehmen nicht nur fachlich exzellent, sondern auch zukunftsfähig zu begleiten. Dafür entwickeln wir eine eigene KI-Plattform mit spezialisierten KI-Agenten und Skills, die unsere Teams im Kanzleialltag konkret unterstützen – etwa bei der Aufbereitung von Daten, der Qualitätssicherung, der Recherche und der Erstellung strukturierter Arbeitsergebnisse. Dafür suchen wir Sie: neugierig, technisch versiert und mit Freude daran, aus guten Ideen hilfreiche KI-Anwendungen zu entwickeln – gerne auch vollständig remote. Ihre Aufgaben Sie konzipieren, entwickeln und optimieren KI-Agenten und spezialisierte Skills für interne Arbeitsabläufe. Sie übersetzen Anforderungen aus der Steuerberatung , Wirtschaftsprüfung und Unternehmensberatung in klare und robuste KI-Workflows. Sie formulieren und optimieren Prompts , Entscheidungslogiken und strukturierte Fragebögen . Sie testen Ergebnisse systematisch, erkennen Fehlerbilder und entwickeln unsere Qualitätsstandards weiter. Sie unterstützen bei der Anbindung und Nutzung von Datenquellen und Tools , beispielsweise DATEV-Exporte, Tabellen, Dokumente oder interne Wissensbestände. Sie dokumentieren Lösungen verständlich und sorgen dafür, dass Kolleginnen und Kollegen diese sicher anwenden können. Sie verfolgen neue Entwicklungen rund um KI-Agenten , Large Language Models und Automatisierung und bringen geeignete Ideen pragmatisch in die Umsetzung. Für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung Ihrer Ideen erhalten Sie Zugriff auf gängige KI- und Coding-Tools wie Claude und Codex. Ihr Profil Sie studieren Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit Digital- oder Technologieschwerpunkt oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für künstliche Intelligenz, insbesondere für Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering oder agentische Workflows. Idealerweise bringen Sie erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Python, APIs, Datenaufbereitung, Automatisierung oder Vibe Coding mit. Sie arbeiten strukturiert, denken analytisch und geben sich nicht mit einer Antwort zufrieden, nur weil diese überzeugend klingt. Sie können komplexe Themen verständlich erklären und arbeiten gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen. Vorkenntnisse in der Steuerberatung, im Rechnungswesen oder im Umgang mit DATEV sind willkommen, aber kein Muss – Ihr Interesse und Ihre Lernbereitschaft zählen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Ihr Profil ab. Warum wir? Flexibel bleiben: Arbeitszeiten, die zu Studium, Alltag und Leben passen. Weiterkommen: Fort- und Weiterbildungen, die zu Ihren Stärken und Zielen passen. Gesehen werden: Ihr Einsatz zählt – und wird wertgeschätzt. Ideen einbringen: Kurze Wege, offene Türen und Raum für Ihre Perspektive. Sicher starten: HWS gibt es seit 1923 – und trotzdem schauen wir nach vorn. Modern & zukunftsorientiert: Digitale Prozesse und gezielter Einsatz von KI für mehr Raum für wirklich wichtige Aufgaben. International vernetzt, fachlich stark: Internationales Partner- und Expertennetzwerk für vielfältige fachliche Perspektiven. Einfach ausgezeichnet: HWS ist als Arbeitgeber mehrfach ausgezeichnet – unter anderem mit dem TOP JOB Award 2026 . Mehr für Sie: Moderne Arbeitsplätze, Rabatte für Mitarbeitende und Angebote rund um Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden. Echt im Team: Menschen, die zusammenhalten, sich unterstützen und den HWS-Spirit leben. Ansprechpartner Frau Beatrix Dreher HWS GmbH & Co. raw.title: SRE Manager
raw.description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world's most experienced core blockchain infrastructure companies, having built and pioneered some of the most advanced technologies in the blockchain sector. Parity was founded by Dr. Gavin Wood, co-founder and former CTO of Ethereum, the primary engineer behind the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), inventor of the Solidity programming language, and primary author of the Ethereum Yellowpaper.

People in Our Collective Are

  • Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger

  • Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex

  • Autonomous workers that self-initiate, but also collaborate well with others

  • Taking maximum accountability and having minimum ego at work

  • Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space

  • Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider ecosystem

About the Team

The SRE team is responsible for the infrastructure that makes the Polkadot platform and technology work: test and production network environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and the systems that developers, node operators, and end-user applications across the ecosystem rely on. This spans the full stack from runtime and parachain development environments through to infrastructure supporting live applications and events.

We run environments at different stability tiers, from fast-moving test networks with daily automated updates to production networks with 24/7 on-call coverage. It's a small team, so the role carries broad scope.

The Role

We're looking for an engineering manager who can lead a team of experienced SRE engineers and raise the standard of what reliability looks like in a blockchain infrastructure context.

The team is technically capable. What it needs is someone who can set engineering direction, build the conditions for good work, and think clearly about reliability as a discipline: SLOs, error budgets, blameless postmortems.

What We're Looking For

Systems thinking. You have a genuine understanding of distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure. You don't need to be the most senior engineer technically, but you need to be credible to people who are.

Reliability. You've worked in or led a team that takes SRE seriously. You know what error budgets are actually for, when SLOs are miscalibrated, and how to run postmortems that improve things.

Automation. You get uncomfortable when skilled engineers spend time on work a machine could do. You've built teams that automate away the repetitive work rather than just absorbing it.

People development. You have a track record of engineers growing under your leadership, ideally some of them moving on to bigger things.

Comfort with unusual territory. Blockchain infrastructure has properties that don't map cleanly onto standard cloud operations. You don't need prior Web3 experience, but you shouldn't be put off by it either.

Working at Parity

Remote-first, with offices in Berlin, Lisbon, and London. Parity is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

title: Senior Brand Partnerships & Licensing Manager (All Genders)
description: YOU & AHEAD At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world's candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves, reformulated with less sugar and zero compromise on taste. You run an active pipeline of 5-10 live opportunities at any given time and know which ones are worth pursuing for our brand and commercial goals. Deal Negotiation & Contracting: You lead negotiations end-to-end and close with confidence. LOIs, licensing agreements, talent contracts, commercial terms, royalties, usage rights. You represent us in front of top-tier partners, agents, and IP holders and you get deals across the line. End-to-End Project Management: You own the full lifecycle of every limited edition. Concept, LOI, product development, packaging redesign, legal sign-off, market launch. You keep cross-functional teams across brand, product, design, legal, sales, retail, and D2C moving in the same direction and on time. Business Case & Performance Ownership: You build and own the business case for every collaboration: budget, margin, revenue forecast, and post-launch review. Internal Alignment & Launch Enablement: You brief and align brand, social, ecom, and retail on launch strategy, content needs, and sell-in materials so every edition lands the way it should, in-store and online. YOUR PROFILE You bring 5+ years in licensing, brand partnerships, or co-branding, ideally within FMCG, consumer lifestyle, entertainment, or a licensing/talent agency. You have taken 3+ limited editions or co-branded drops from concept to launch and can point to the results. You are a strategic thinker with a hands-on mindset and a proven execution track record. You have negotiated and signed LOIs, licensing agreements, and talent contracts with full commercial responsibility. You come with a network of IP holders, agencies, talent managers, and entertainment companies that opens doors from day one. You are comfortable juggling multiple complex workstreams at once, aligning cross-functional teams without formal authority, and holding a timeline without micromanaging. You have owned 6-7 figure budgets and built business cases from zero. You communicate with confidence in both German and English. Native-level German and full fluency in English are required. You take responsibility for your projects and your numbers, make clear decisions even when the path is not, and thrive where speed and ownership matter. WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE Experience working directly with entertainment studios, IP holders, or major talent agencies. Background in FMCG, food & beverage, or better-for-you consumer brands. Existing relationships in the DACH retail landscape with sell-in experience for limited editions. Track record managing both D2C and retail launches at the same time. Degree in Marketing, Media & Communications Management, Business Administration, or similar, though your track record matters far more than the diploma. AND WHY AHEAD? Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together. Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more) Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve) Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget For this role, you can choose whether to work from our offices in Hamburg or Berlin, or fully remotely from anywhere in Germany. raw.description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going
 
Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.
 
Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.
 
With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.
 
If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! 

Role Overview

The Account Manager is responsible for developing and expanding relationships with existing customers, ensuring customer success, maximizing the value customers realize from Magnet Forensics’ solutions, and identifying opportunities to grow customer adoption across our portfolio of products and services.


What You’ll Do
  • Develop and execute annual and quarterly account growth and customer success plans
  • Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across law enforcement and government organizations
  • Help drive customer retention and long-term account development
  • Identify opportunities for cross-sell and upsell within existing customer accounts
  • Conduct regular business reviews and customer success discussions to understand evolving customer needs
  • Prepare and deliver customer presentations, solution overviews, and value-based discussions
  • Coordinate and support product evaluations, upgrades, and adoption initiatives
  • Accurately manage quotations, renewals, and related commercial processes
  • Maintain complete and accurate records of all customer engagements and opportunities within Magnet’s CRM system
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Technical Specialists, and Marketing teams to ensure outstanding customer outcomes
  • Serve as a strategic advisor by helping customers achieve their operational and investigative objectives through the effective use of Magnet solutions
  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, providing feedback to product and leadership teams

What We’re Looking For
  • Experience managing and growing customer relationships in a software, technology, or services environment
  • Strong consultative communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Proven ability to drive customer retention, expansion, and long-term account growth
  • Ability to understand customer challenges and align solutions to business outcomes
  • Previous Law Enforcement or Digital Forensic experience is an asset

    • *There will be some travel required for this role and it can be expected about 25% of the time

Compensation & Benefits 

The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location and you are selected for an interview, the Talent Acquisition Partner can share more information with you.  If the compensation structure for the role includes an incentive component (i.e. most Sales roles) the range below represents total target compensation (TTC) (base salary + variable).


€94,100- €134,400 (EUR) a year

Salary range (min - max)

Position Type: Current Vacancy 

 


Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: 
 
- Generous time off policies 
- Competitive compensation 
- Volunteer opportunities  
- Reward and recognition programs   
- Employee committees & resource groups  
 
Indicators of Success
 
We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”.  It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”.  We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. 
 
How We Work
 
At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.
 
We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!
 
The Most Important Thing
 
We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:
 
CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.
OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.
DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.
EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.
 
Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.
 
Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact
 
All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment.
 
US Applicants: Magnet Forensics participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

title: Customer Success Manager - German Market (Berlin)
description: At Lexroom , we set the bar for legal AI—clear, fast, and built for trust. In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by thousands of legal professionals across Europe . Our mission is clear : make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable , giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters. We're growing fast, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team committed to rigor, clarity, and impact. Today, Lexroom is a trusted partner , shaping the evolution of legal AI with the same rigor and precision that define our product. Join us as Customer Success Manager to build Lexroom's German customer base from the ground up. You will be the first dedicated CS hire for the German market , owning the full portfolio of German customers end to end. The product already won in Italy, with the numbers to prove it. Germany is next, and you own it. Your key responsibilities Own the full German customer portfolio from handover to renewal, with a clear goal: keep every customer (retention first) and grow each account through proactive upsell and uplift. Run a proactive, commercial CS motion. You do not wait for customers to call. You call them, spot the opportunity in every conversation, and bring it home. Be the single point of contact for German customers, from onboarding and product expertise to support requests, gathering feedback and feeding it back to Product and Marketing. Adapt the Italian playbook to Germany , importing what works and localizing it for the German market. Own your numbers: build dashboards, monitor KPIs, and report on the health and growth of your portfolio. What we're looking for 2 to 4 years in Customer Success or account management, ideally at a SaaS, tech, or software company. Exposure to legal or professional-services customers is a plus. A commercial mindset. You see every customer touch as a chance to add value and expand the account. Direct sales experience is a plus, not a requirement. CRM fluency. Experience working a portfolio in a CRM; HubSpot is a plus. Comfort building in a fast-moving market and staying hands-on, including operational support, while the market scales. Languages: native-level German and fluent English are required . Based in Berlin or willing to relocate. How we work Lexroom is building the platform where legal work gets done. Founded in Milan in 2023, we are the legal AI built data-first for civil-law Europe: a proprietary base of 7M+ verified legal sources, used today by 12,000+ law firms and in-house legal teams. We recently closed a USD 50M Series B led by Left Lane Capital, with investors including Base10 Partners and Eurazeo, bringing total funding to over USD 73M, to expand across Europe starting with Spain and Germany. We move fast and accurate, own outcomes, and say what we mean. Impact is defined by execution, not by title. What Sets Us Apart An Exceptional Team. At Lexroom, you'll work alongside top talent in tech and legal AI. Our focused teams operate with purpose and autonomy, so every contribution delivers visible results. You'll collaborate with people who pair innovation with rigor, curiosity with discipline, ambition with depth. Growth that Matters. We hire exceptional people to make a difference—and we give them space to lead. Your work will shape the future of legal technology and set new standards for the field. Impact is defined by vision and execution, not by age or title. If you're ready to take responsibility, you'll find real opportunities to grow and lead high-stakes projects. Rewarding Your Contribution. We value excellence and share success: Annual Salary Range: €65K – 75K€ Equity Package: Align your growth with the company's long-term success. Benefits That Matter Hybrid Work: Split your time between working from home and collaborating in our Berlin office three days a week, with flexibility. Performance Bonuses: Rewards tied directly to measurable results. Team Retreats & Off-sites: Dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas. Hiring process and timeline Intro call with our Talent team: motivations, fit, and the essentials Interview with the Team Manager: your experience and potential for the role Interview with the German Team : get to know each other and discuss upcoming challenges together Last step: Meet the Global Head of Customer Success to get to know each other and discuss Lexroom values Practical exercise: a real customer scenario you prepare in advance, then a live call simulation with the Team Manager and the German Team At Lexroom, ambition meets discipline and purpose. We're not just building a product—we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you. You will join our global Finance team, report to the VP of FP&A, and work alongside the other FP&A leads - with scope that will grow as Camunda does.

What you'll be doing:

  •  Business Partnership: Serve as the primary finance partner to SLT, supporting decisions on hiring, investment prioritization, and resource allocation

  • P&L Ownership: Own the P&Ls end to end — budgeting, monthly forecasting, variance analysis, and the "what changed, why it matters, what we do next" narrative for leadership.

  • Financial Modeling: Build and continuously improve driver-based models, such as the long-range plan, bookings model, and ad hoc analyses.

  • Planning & Forecasting: Lead planning cadences (annual, quarterly, monthly outlooks) and integrate business partners' inputs into the corporate forecast alongside our FP&A leads.

  • Team Leadership: Manage and develop one Senior Financial Analyst, setting priorities and raising the bar on quality and speed of analysis.

  • Systems & Automation: Own Adaptive Planning administration and maintenance, and drive AI-augmented workflows that make FP&A faster and more scalable.

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • 6+ years of progressive FP&A or strategic finance experience, including directly partnering with C-Level, and/or CRO/CMO

  • Direct people management experience (you've hired, coached, and managed the performance of finance team members, not just mentored or led projects)

  • Deep fluency in SaaS cost structures and unit economics — cloud/hosting costs, CoGS vs. OpEx, gross margin drivers — with proven driver-based modeling skills (forecasting from usage and consumption drivers, not trending actuals)

  • Hands-on experience building in an enterprise planning platform (Adaptive, Anaplan, Pigment, Planful, or similar) plus advanced spreadsheet skills — we'll ramp you on Adaptive Planning

  • Clear, executive-ready communicator who works autonomously and with focus, integrity, and humility

Nice-to-haves:

  • Adaptive Planning experience specifically (you'll own our instance)

  • Salesforce

  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude) to automate finance workflows — this team builds with AI daily

ROLE OVERVIEW
 
The Business Development Director is a key member of the global Park IP Commercial team, responsible for driving revenue growth through new business acquisition, strategic account expansion, and long-term client partnerships. This role focuses on identifying opportunities within the Intellectual Property (IP), Legal Services, and related technology sectors while positioning Park IP's solutions as a trusted partner for corporate legal departments and law firms. 
 
The successful candidate will own the full sales lifecycle—from prospecting and pipeline generation through negotiation and closing—while working closely with Operations, Solutions, Project Management, and Executive Leadership to deliver exceptional customer experiences. This is a highly collaborative role requiring strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a global organization. 
 
Travel will be required to support client meetings, industry events, and business development activities.
 
MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
 
  • Drive new business growth by identifying, qualifying, and closing opportunities within assigned territories and target markets.
  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve or exceed annual revenue and pipeline targets.
  • Manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
  • Generate a qualified pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, industry events, and existing relationships.
  • Identify opportunities to expand business within existing client accounts through cross-selling and upselling initiatives.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with key decision-makers across corporate legal departments, law firms, and other target organizations.
  • Understand client business challenges and position Park IP's solutions to address their strategic objectives.
  • Act as the primary commercial point of contact throughout the sales process, ensuring a high-quality client experience.
  • Collaborate with Operations, Program Directors, Project Managers, and Solution teams to develop tailored proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), Requests for Proposal (RFPs), pricing, and commercial solutions.
  • Partner with the global commercial team to define value propositions, sales strategies, and service offerings that support business growth.
  • Provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and customer feedback to support product and commercial strategy.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity management, forecasting, and pipeline reporting within Salesforce.
  • Deliver reliable 30-, 60-, and 90-day sales forecasts and provide regular updates on sales performance and business opportunities.
  • Monitor market trends and identify emerging opportunities within the IP, Legal Services, and technology sectors.
  • Represent Park IP at industry conferences, client meetings, and networking events to strengthen brand awareness and generate new business opportunities.
  • Promote Park IP's expertise, technology, and value proposition within the legal and intellectual property markets.
REQUIREMENTS
 
Experience
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Extensive experience in Business Development, Sales, or Account Management within the Legal Services, Intellectual Property (IP), eDiscovery, Litigation, Legal Technology, SaaS, or Legal Translation/Localization industries.
  • Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Demonstrated success in identifying, developing, and closing complex enterprise sales opportunities.
  • Experience managing both new business acquisition and strategic account growth.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations is preferred.
Technical Skills  
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or another enterprise CRM platform.
  • Comfortable preparing commercial proposals, pricing, Statements of Work (SOWs), and responding to RFPs.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills and overall digital proficiency.
 Competencies 
  • Excellent commercial and negotiation skills.
  • Strong consultative selling and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to identify growth opportunities and develop long-term account strategies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and comfortable working independently within a collaborative global environment.
  • Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and work effectively with multicultural teams.

description: <h1 style="text-align: center;">Senior Product Engineer II</h1> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);">Team: Engineering&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>&nbsp;&nbsp;Prolific</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.</span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>The role</em></span></p> <p data-start="88" data-end="548"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">As a Senior Product Engineer II you will be the senior technical contributor for your team, partnering with the Engineering Manager to set technical direction and ensure delivery excellence. You will balance hands-on contribution with technical leadership, serving as the go-to person for technical decisions and architecture within your team's domain. You are increasingly outward-facing, representing your team's technical work beyond its boundaries.</span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>What you’ll be doing in the role</em></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Define Technical Direction:</strong> Partner with the EM to shape the team’s technical roadmap, strategy, and architectural direction.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Drive Engineering Excellence:</strong> Own code quality, testing, reliability, performance, and engineering standards across the team.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Lead Technical Discovery:</strong> Guide technical planning, discovery, solution design, and decision-making, balancing short- and long-term needs.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Collaborate and Influence:</strong> Facilitate cross-team technical collaboration, contribute to engineering-wide initiatives, and act as a technical liaison.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Grow the Team:</strong> Actively mentor and develop engineers at any level, within and beyond the team.</span></li> </ul> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><em>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141);">What you'll bring to this role</span></em></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Technical Leadership:</strong> Proven experience leading technical direction, making architectural decisions, and solving complex engineering problems.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Engineering Expertise:</strong> Deep expertise in software engineering, architecture, testing, reliability, performance, and maintainable system design.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Product Mindset:</strong> Ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes while balancing delivery with long-term technical health.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Influence and Communication:</strong> Strong communication skills with the ability to build consensus, influence across teams, and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Mentoring and Collaboration:</strong> A strong track record of developing engineers, working effectively with EMs and wider engineering communities, and contributing to a culture of learning and excellence.</span></li> </ul> <p style="text-align: center;"><em>Key Technologies.</em></p> <p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><em>We ask for expertise in some, and the willingness to learn where required</em></span></p> <ul> <li style="text-align: left; font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Cloud Platforms</strong>: AWS and GCP</span></li> <li style="text-align: left; font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Programming Languages</strong>: Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript</span></li> <li style="text-align: left; font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Frameworks</strong>: Vue.js, Django Rest Framework, Container-based and Serverless architectures</span></li> <li style="text-align: left; font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Databases</strong>: MongoDB and DynamoDB</span></li> <li style="text-align: left; font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>DevOps and Monitoring:</strong> CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, Celery, EventBridge and DataDog</span></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>Why Prolific is a great place to work</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

This is a rare opportunity to build a truly strategic Deal Desk function at Perk — one that shapes how our Sales organisation structures, prices, and closes its most complex, high-value deals. We're investing in this transformation now, and we want a leader who can turn that ambition into reality.

We're hiring a Senior Deal Desk Manager to lead this shift. You'll take ownership of the Deal Desk team and its transformation, personally running point on our most complex and strategic deals while building a team that operates as trusted commercial partners to Sales, Finance, and Legal. A major part of the role will be modernising how the team works: automating manual processes through AI and automation, and improving our CPQ and quoting systems so Sales can move faster with confidence.

This is a coach-player role: you'll lead and develop a team while staying hands-on with the deals that matter most.


What You'll Do

Lead the transformation

  • Rebuild Deal Desk's operating model so the team spends its time on complex deal structuring and pricing strategy for high-value opportunities, not manual admin like company setup or payment profile processing — and put in place the triage, tools, and ways of working that make that shift stick.

  • Decide what Deal Desk should own, support, automate, or hand off to other teams, and build the case for change with Legal, Finance, and Sales Operations leadership.

  • Agree clear ownership and service levels for work that moves to other teams (for example, NDAs, supplier and financial forms, payment term changes, and downgrade/churn processing), so handovers actually stick.

  • Build performance metrics and reporting to track deal velocity, team output, and the impact of process and automation improvements over time.

  • Represent Deal Desk as a trusted, credible partner in cross-functional forums and with Sales leadership.

Lead the team and run point on complex deals

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of Deal Desk professionals, setting clear goals and performance standards as the team matures into a more strategic function.

  • Act as a coach-player: personally run point on Perk's most complex, highest-value deals, modelling the standard of deal structuring, negotiation support, and stakeholder management expected of the team.

  • Own pricing governance and deal structuring for complex, non-standard commercial deals, balancing commercial risk with deal velocity.

  • Mentor the team on complex deal structuring, pricing strategy, and commercial risk judgement, and coach them through escalations.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product to unblock deals and resolve cross-functional friction quickly.

Own our systems and quoting experience

  • Own the relationship with our CPQ platform end to end, bringing prior experience owning a complex CPQ implementation elsewhere.

  • Identify and drive improvements to CPQ configuration, pricing logic, and quoting workflows so Sales can quote and close faster with confidence.

  • Act as the primary Deal Desk voice in Revenue Systems and CPQ/CLM tooling roadmap decisions.

Drive automation and AI

  • Own the automation roadmap for Deal Desk, with a clear mandate to remove manual, repetitive work from the team through AI and automation.

  • Prioritise and deliver automation of the highest-impact manual workflows first, such as company and payment profile setup and post-signature subscription provisioning, which today account for a significant share of the team's ticket volume.

  • Partner with engineering/systems teams to scope, sequence, and deliver automation initiatives, and track the time saved and volume shifted off manual processing.

  • Evaluate and pilot AI tools for use cases such as contract redline review, NDA triage, and deal risk flagging, working closely with Legal.

Protect the business

  • Act as Deal Desk's first line of defense on contract redlines and non-standard deal terms, escalating to Legal or Finance where needed.

  • Own commercial governance frameworks, pricing and discounting policy, and approval structures across the function.

  • Safeguard deal commercials, business risk, and revenue recognition implications on complex and non-standard deals.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong Deal Desk experience within B2B SaaS, ideally spanning mid-market and enterprise segments.

  • Proven experience leading a Deal Desk (or equivalent commercial/sales operations) team, with direct people management responsibility.

  • A genuine coach-player: comfortable personally running complex, high-value deals while simultaneously leading and developing a team.

  • Prior ownership of a complex CPQ platform, with a track record of driving measurable improvements to quoting, pricing, and deal velocity for Sales.

  • Experience scoping and delivering automation and/or AI initiatives that reduce manual operational work, ideally in partnership with engineering or systems teams.

  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder management skills, comfortable partnering across Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment where processes are still being defined and improved.


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex.

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva.

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.

  • Rest assured that you're covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence.

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus.

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks' paid parental leave.

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards.

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years.

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

raw.description:
Strategic Finance Manager — The Flex

The Flex is creating the future of flexible accommodation.

We operate and manage properties across multiple cities and countries, bringing together hospitality, technology and operational excellence to make renting a home as effortless as booking a hotel.

As our international footprint expands, we are searching for an outstanding Strategic Finance Manager to help build the financial systems, controls and insights required to support a rapidly growing global business.

This is far more than a conventional accounting position. You will work closely with our founders and leadership team, take ownership of essential financial processes, evaluate business performance and provide the insights that enable better decisions as we scale.

Your Mission

As Strategic Finance Manager, you will play a central role in The Flex’s financial operations.

Your objective will be to give the business complete clarity over where its revenue comes from, how its money is spent, how each area is performing and where profitability can be improved.

Your responsibilities will span accounting, financial analysis, management reporting, payment reconciliation, budgeting and business performance.

You will have exposure to the entire organisation, collaborating directly with operations, revenue management, property teams and senior leadership.

For an ambitious individual, this position offers a clear path toward becoming Head of Finance or, ultimately, moving into a CFO-track role as The Flex continues to grow.

What You Will Own

  • Lead and continuously strengthen our day-to-day financial controls and reporting, ensuring that every number shared with management is accurate, validated, complete and supported by reliable evidence.

  • Identify repetitive and manual finance tasks, create more efficient processes and collaborate with our engineering teams to automate them.

  • Reconcile payments from Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, direct reservations and other distribution partners, confirming that every expected payment is received correctly and on schedule.

  • Reconcile bank accounts and incoming transactions, ensuring that funds are properly received and recorded while investigating and resolving discrepancies quickly.

  • Monitor and manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

  • Review supplier invoices and expenses incurred across the company.

  • Oversee statutory filings and corporate compliance requirements across several jurisdictions, making sure that all submissions are correct and completed within the required deadlines.

  • Coordinate with external accountants, tax advisers, auditors and banking partners to maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely compliance.

  • Assist with financial statements for landlords and property owners whenever required.

  • Develop dashboards and reporting tools that provide management with real-time visibility into company performance.

  • Evaluate financial results across individual properties, cities, countries and business units.

  • Create and maintain company budgets, forecasts and financial models.

  • Track cash flow and support management in planning future funding and capital needs.

  • Detect financial risks, discrepancies and potential sources of revenue leakage.

  • Review the company’s cost base and uncover opportunities to strengthen margins.

  • Partner with operational teams to understand, control and reduce costs at property level.

  • Contribute to financial due diligence for acquisitions, investments and expansion into new markets.

  • Communicate financial findings, recommendations and actionable insights directly to the founders and management team.

What We Are Looking For

  • A highly analytical individual who is confident and comfortable working with numbers.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and an uncompromising approach to financial accuracy.

  • A strong understanding of accounting concepts and financial principles.

  • The ability to work effectively with significant volumes of financial and operational data.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Strong capabilities in financial reconciliation, controls and problem-solving.

  • A commercial mindset—you do more than report figures; you understand their meaning and implications for the wider business.

  • A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability.

  • The confidence to work independently, find solutions and navigate unfamiliar challenges.

  • The ability to perform in a fast-paced environment where priorities may evolve quickly.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • The confidence to communicate and work directly with senior management.

  • A genuine interest in technology, automation and AI, together with the ability to identify opportunities to improve and automate finance processes.

  • The ambition to grow quickly and assume substantially greater responsibility over time.

  • Experience in accounting, audit, investment banking, private equity, FP&A, consulting, hospitality, real estate or a high-growth startup would be highly valuable.

  • A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Mathematics or another analytical discipline is preferred, although exceptional applicants from other backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

What Success Will Look Like

During your first 6–12 months, you will have:

  • Developed a detailed understanding of the financial performance of every major area of The Flex.

  • Established dependable monthly management reporting across the company.

  • Ensured that payments from booking platforms and commercial partners are fully reconciled and that all expected funds are received.

  • Significantly improved visibility into cash flow, profitability and unit economics.

  • Uncovered meaningful opportunities to lower costs and improve margins.

  • Automated several finance processes that were previously completed manually.

  • Established yourself as a trusted financial partner to the founders and management team.

  • Taken responsibility for increasingly important areas of the company’s finance function.

Why Join The Flex?

  • Become part of a rapidly growing international business operating at the intersection of real estate, hospitality and technology.

  • Work closely and directly with the company’s founders and senior leaders.

  • Gain hands-on exposure to the financial operations of a business spanning multiple countries.

  • Influence profitability and contribute directly to major strategic and commercial decisions.

  • Help design and build the finance function instead of simply taking over an established set of processes.

  • Apply technology and AI to reimagine how a modern finance function should operate.

  • Take meaningful ownership and responsibility from your first day.

  • Receive a competitive salary together with performance-based incentives.

  • Benefit from exceptional long-term career progression as The Flex continues its international expansion.

You Should Not Apply If

  • You want a conventional corporate 9-to-5 position with limited and narrowly defined responsibilities.

  • You rely on someone else to continuously tell you what needs to be done.

  • You are uncomfortable taking responsibility and being accountable for the quality of your work.

  • You would rather report financial figures than understand, challenge and improve them.

  • You engage in workplace politics, gossip or conversations about colleagues behind their backs.

  • You are searching for a slow-moving, predictable role with limited career progression.

  • You do not aspire to become one of the very best in the world at what you do.

description: <p><strong>Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy &amp; Measurement</strong></p> <p><em>Location: Remote</em> — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.</p> <p><strong>The Role </strong></p> <p>The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy &amp; Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.</p> <p><strong>Top Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Client Measurement &amp; Data Strategy</strong></p> <p>• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.</p> <p>• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.</p> <p>• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.</p> <p>• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.</p> <p>• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.</p> <p><strong>Strategic Consulting &amp; Problem Solving</strong></p> <p>• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.</p> <p>• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.</p> <p>• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.</p> <p>• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.</p> <p><strong>Data Products &amp; Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.</strong></p> <p>• Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p>• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools.</p> <p>• Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities.</p> <p><strong>Data Enablement &amp; Industry Thought Leadership</strong></p> <p>• Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks.</p> <p>• Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients.</p> <p>• Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums.</p> <p>• Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms.</p> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like:</strong></p> <p><strong>By 6 Months</strong></p> <p>The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams.</p> <p><strong>By 1 Year</strong></p> <p>The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. raw.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build.

This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments.

Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our London office.

About the Role

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com.

What You'll Do

Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout.

Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there.

Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself.

Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

What we promise

This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full-stack depth

  • Experience leading hands-on projects end-to-end in a production environment, preferably client-facing

  • Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, evals, and prompt-to-production workflows

  • Experience navigating C-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments

  • Track record of turning one-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks
