What does a Senior Post Producer do at WPP Production?

You'll play a central role in delivering high-quality post-production projects across edit, grade, VFX, motion, and sound. As a Senior Post Producer you will bridge hands-on production and leadership, managing key projects, supporting producers, and maintaining strong relationships with clients, agencies, and creative partners. You'll ensure projects run smoothly, budgets are met, and the creative standard remains high across everything that leaves the studio. You'll be someone who thrives on collaboration, solves problems calmly under pressure, and takes pride in delivering work that looks, sounds, and feels exceptional. The ideal candidate will have experience working with a global technology brand or demonstrate a strong drive and ambition to contribute to a high-calibre account. 

Responsibilities

Production

  • Lead multiple post-production projects from brief to final delivery, managing timelines, budgets and workflows.
  • Oversee offline, online, grade, VFX, motion graphics and audio, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.
  • Own production workflows, tracking progress, risks and budgets and keeping the Executive Producer informed.
  • Proactively identify and resolve challenges, balancing creative, technical and commercial priorities.
  • Manage global workflows across a centralised production hub and continuously improve ways of working.
  • Explore and implement AI and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, quality and output.

Clients & Collaboration

  • Act as a senior point of contact for clients and agency partners throughout production.
  • Lead client calls, reviews and presentations, building trusted relationships and managing expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with creatives, artists, technical teams and senior production leads to deliver high-quality work.
  • Support and mentor junior and mid-level producers, sharing best practice and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Quality & Commercial

  • Own the studio QC process, ensuring work meets brand, technical and delivery standards.
  • Develop and implement robust QC workflows and best practices.
  • Prepare budgets and estimates, maintaining accurate financial tracking and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Contribute to rate cards, templates and processes that strengthen production and commercial performance.

Requirements

  • Strong post-production experience across broadcast, digital and social.
  • Senior-level experience managing complex, high-end campaigns from brief to delivery.
  • Strong understanding of the full post-production pipeline, including edit, colour, online, VFX and audio.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communicator, confident working with clients, agency partners and internal teams.
  • Experience managing international clients and senior stakeholders across multiple markets.
  • Calm, organised and solutions-focused, with the ability to stay composed under pressure.
  • Collaborative team player who leads by example and supports the development of others.
  • Passionate about craft, creativity, technology and innovation, with a strong eye for detail and efficiency.
  • Genuine interest in technology brands and the wider tech landscape.
  • Flexible and adaptable when project deadlines require occasional evening or weekend support. We value work-life balance and these instances are infrequent, with time off in lieu provided where appropriate.

At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Account Director do at WPP Production? 


Our Account Director (AD) are knowledgeable and trusted Client leads.  Accountable for end-to-end project delivery, management of client and agency relationships, they lead a diverse and dynamic team to deliver. Responsible for operational discipline, delivery, resource optimisation and profitability management across Clients and projects. You are the key point person for the projects you are leading and are responsible for delivering on time, on specification and on budget. 

You possess problem-solving skills, have a passion for production, marketing and advertising and a desire to learn. Highly organised and accountable, you build trusting Client and team relationships, collaborate across multi-disciplined teams and draw on the expertise of Hogarth's resources and capabilities. You are ensure we execute flawlessly. 

 

Key areas of responsibility 

Communication 

  • Responsible for managing the day to day client relationship with a focus on Client delivery
  • Oversee the on-time delivery of projects and ensure the smooth delivery and swift resolution of issues to maintain client confidence in WPP's capabilities to deliver
  • The key day-to-day Client Delivery contact with clients, agencies and all associated WPP's teams
  • Understanding of client's needs to deliver high satisfaction levels and share feedback with wider team and escalate any delivery concerns to Senior Account Director / Client Director
  • Act as the primary client contact for project delivery, structuring regular status and communications with clients, defining scope and approach, setting and managing expectations and deliverables and troubleshooting issues as they arise
  • Work with client brands and agencies to ensure a clear understanding of the production brief, deliverables and timeline for each project and relay those details to other members of the team as necessary
  • Accountable for ensuring all team members are aware of timelines and deliverables

 

Collaboration 

  • Partner with Client Services, Production and Finance to ensure a smooth process, proper resource allocation and a superior result
  • Develop and maintain high levels of team effectiveness, trust, communication, collaboration, productivity, diversity, engagement and ensure the team feel personal accountability for deliverables and projects
  • Demonstrate strong collaboration skills with internal agency teams and key external partners to ensure quality and adherence to production guidelines for key deliverables 

 

Process 

  • Manage medium to complex projects independently and with a team, from initiation through to completion
  • Work collaboratively with all internal team members to facilitate the process of developing effective strategies and briefs that lead to great work
  • Understand and anticipate client needs, taking them into account when framing and making delivery decisions
  • Possess an understanding of project and client management techniques and bring process innovation to how we manage our engagements
  • Manage client objectives, budget, expectations, deliverables and timelines and communicate changes/direction to team members
  • Keep projects on track through clear team status, task lists, timing schedules, risk register, trackers, status and contact reports
  • Participate actively and knowledgably articulate status internally and during client interactions
  • Leverage our on-site, onshore, offshore network to deliver great work in the most efficient and effective way
  • Identify improvements to existing workflow and processes 
  • Identify potential project risks and develop contingency plans and if needed, escalate to Senior Account Director / Client Director
  • Review team structure and resources on an ongoing basis to ensure client is serviced appropriately 
  • Ensure the highest quality is always delivered to clients

 

Leadership 

  • Create a culture of fresh-thinking, collaboration, respect, equality, diversity and inclusion, with a focus on learning, development and growth
  • Contribute to WPPs culture by exhibiting ownership, professionalism, passion and leading by example
  • Take ownership and find solutions, whilst supporting the wider team by removing any barriers to success
  • Retain the best talent

 

Financials 

  • Demonstrate strong commercial abilities and business and financial acumen
  • Own project budgets and tracking of all ongoing costs throughout project lifecycle, reconcile estimates to actuals on all projects, and resolution of budget discrepancies between disciplines, vendors and clients
  • Manage POs, financial reporting, tracking, billing against all project budgets
  • Manage financial aspects of assigned accounts including development of SOW and change orders, estimates, profitability analysis, and utilization, working with Finance where appropriate
  • Responsible for monthly billing and tracking of all production budgets
  • Ensure a thorough understanding of commercial arrangements, and SLA's across assigned accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the broader team
  • Protect margins
  • Proactively seek and identify new revenue opportunities across your clients

 

Requirements 

  • Project / Client management related experience within an interactive or integrated agency, with a good understanding of marketing and production implementation processes across all key channels, including digital, video, content, social etc
  • Good understanding of production and the creative development process, content production, technology, quality assurance testing and marketing methodologies
  • Ability to manage complex projects with varying components, demonstrating ability to deliver on time and on budget 
  • Experience of building solid client relationships
  • A professional, calm, approachable demeanour, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic highly matrixed agency environment
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and relationships cross functionally
  • An appreciation for how great work gets done and a commitment to ensuring flawless execution and delivery
  • Proven ability to collaborate with dynamic cross-functional teams to deliver on projects 
  • Demonstrates an ability to solve problems with the solution that works for all stakeholders without compromising the quality of the deliverables or the project 
  • Must be commercially astute able to build scopes, create budgets and track profitability 
  • Proven negotiation skills
  • Strong client relationship skills including presenting to clients and the ability to think on your feet
  • Strong written/oral communication skills
  • Experience of working with offshore teams a plus 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, wireframing/workflow tools, online project management/collaboration/ticketing tools e.g. JIRA, Smartsheet, Trello, Miro etc

 

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Contract
description: What is Flagstone? Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work. Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage. A feel for our culture: To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth. That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it. We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three. But enough about us. Let’s talk about you. About the team Security Engineering is a team of five covering cloud security, detection, and security operations. They work directly in the Azure estate and are close to the infrastructure, not abstracted behind a policy layer. The team runs Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, and Defender for Cloud, and manages tooling through infrastructure-as-code. They run a quarterly penetration test programme and are continuously building out our detection and response capability. It's a small team with broad scope, which means your work is visible, your opinions are heard, and there are meaningful problems for our engineers to work on. This is a contract role, so we're looking for someone who can hit the ground running. You'll bring immediate impact and add value from day one, working independently without a long ramp-up. Your work will be visible, and the problems you solve will matter. Does this sound like you? You're a senior security engineer who operates credibly across cloud security, detection tooling, and incident response, without being narrowly specialised. You own meaningful parts of the security stack, contribute hands-on to Azure cloud hardening, and show up reliably when incidents need investigating or pen test cycles need coordinating. You're energised by visible impact, your work matters, and your voice is heard. What you’ll do: Own and operate our alerting and monitoring capability through a transition period, keeping detection and response steady. Maintain and improve our Microsoft Sentinel deployment: writing and tuning detection rules, managing data connectors, and reducing alert noise. Operate and optimise Defender XDR and Defender for Cloud, including policy management and posture recommendations. Maintain and extend automated security checks in our delivery pipelines (shift-left). Drive down time-to-fix on known vulnerabilities, coordinating remediation with engineering squads. Support data-loss-prevention controls that reduce the risk of sensitive data leaving the business. Support safeguards around how the business accesses and uses AI, including securing AI workloads and their data exposure. Investigate suspicious activity surfaced through Sentinel and Defender: triage, escalate, or contain as appropriate. Support incident response, including containment, evidence gathering, and post-incident review. Contribute to detection-as-code and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or Bicep) for security tooling. Coordinate penetration test engagements (scope, logistics, findings review) and work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation. What you’ll bring: Hands-on SIEM experience, ideally Microsoft Sentinel; equivalent platforms (Splunk, Chronicle, QRadar) considered. Practical Azure security experience across Defender for Cloud, Entra ID, Azure networking, and cloud security posture management. Experience writing infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or Bicep in a security engineering context. Experience driving vulnerability remediation cycles with engineering squads. Familiarity with data-loss-prevention controls. Familiarity with AI security considerations (securing AI workloads, data exposure risks) and/or using AI tooling to augment security engineering workflows. Ability to contribute to threat modelling and communicate security risk clearly to engineering and product audiences. A growth mindset and genuine curiosity to keep learning. SC-200 (Microsoft Security Operations Analyst) certification. KQL proficiency for detection rule authoring and threat hunting. Experience working in a similar fintech or financial services environment All are welcome: At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Portfolio Strategy

This role sits at the center of product execution, working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, and other Delivery Managers to ensure teams are aligned on priorities, dependencies, timelines, and changes.

The Senior Delivery Manager will own the operating rhythm of the team: maintaining the backlog and roadmap, running engineering ceremonies, surfacing risks and blockers, and ensuring that changes are communicated clearly—not just what is changing, but why.

  • Able to distinguish between isolated execution problems and broader systemic challenges.

description: <p>Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at <a href="https://bitwarden.com/">bitwarden.com</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Bitwarden is expanding its sales footprint and is looking for an Account Executive focused on the DACH region, professional fluency in English and German is required. This remote role can be based anywhere within the UK.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are seeking an energetic and motivated sales professional with strong sales skills and channel experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 4-8 years of new account or business development experience with a proven track record of engaging the Partner ecosystem to drive success. In your role, you will be responsible for achieving an assigned quota number while also managing lead flow, closing deals, recruiting partners and developing geographical go to market plans.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Effective prospecting and lead management building a 3-5X pipeline within your territory</li> <li>Predominant focus on closing business in companies with 1000+ employees</li> <li>Managing and reporting a sales pipeline within our CRM, bringing the visibility of the revenue accurately, quarterly</li> <li>Territory planning and any sales support required</li> <li>Focus on activities and opportunities delivering short term and long-term revenue</li> <li>Effective and regular networking to attract and influence Partner sales and grow our Partner relationships</li> <li>Use your existing relationships to recruit and onboarding new partners, get them to agree to engage in proactive demand generation activities</li> <li>Maintain a regional partner plan mapping partner strengths (customer relationships, vertical focus, technology specialty) to accounts and target opportunities</li> <li>Track and manage lead flow both inbound and outbound between partners and the Bitwarden Sales team. Proactively communicate with Bitwarden sales leaders on the channel pipeline and forecast</li> <li>Work closely with marketing to deliver marketing events/programs/campaigns that create interest and awareness among partners’ customers. Build and execute joint partner business plans with measurable success</li> <li>Set financial goals for focus partners and ensure goals achievement&nbsp;</li> <li>Drive multiple key channel initiatives in parallel across technical, professional services, and sales</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience</li> <li>4-8 years of outside high-tech IT sales experience. IT security product experience is desirable but not mandatory</li> <li>Experience at a startup or pre $100M revenue company is desirable</li> <li>A proven track-record of driving continued partner growth and revenue</li> <li>Knowledge and strong relationships with SMB and SME focused resellers and MSP partners within a multistate region will be necessary</li> <li>Ability to drive influence and build effective relationships with decision makers across all levels of partner organizations</li> <li>Motivated and focused self-starter with strong leadership skills who can multitask, work independently or within a team</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills including listening, writing and public speaking.</li> <li>Can work in a fast paced, start-up environment</li> <li>An avid channel leader who knows how to teach, enable and motivate partners to find and close business</li> <li>Relationships and strong relationships with top VARs and Integrators</li> <li>Must demonstrate a consistent track record of achieving annual quota targets while providing specific details on key customer wins</li> <li>Possesses a competitive attitude, strong work ethic and thrives in a fast pace, high growth and matrixed organizational environment</li> <li>Positive history of collaborative selling</li> <li>Must be a proficient user of CRM tools and other Gsuite and MS Office tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Screening call with our Recruiting team</li> <li>Interview with our Head of EMEA Sales</li> <li>Interview with our Head of Sales Enablement</li> <li>Interview(s) with the team</li> <li>AE Roleplay Interview</li> </ul> <p><strong>A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US</strong></p> <ul> <li>Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.</li> <li>Become an expert in a growing market. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.</li> <li>Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup.</li> <li>We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p data-start="213" data-end="305">AI is fundamentally changing how developers write, understand, debug, and maintain software.</p> <p data-start="307" data-end="665">At JetBrains, we're exploring what an AI-native development experience should look like for C++ developers. We are looking for a senior technical leader to help shape this future by building AI-powered workflows, integrating coding agents into developer tools, and defining how CLion can become a first-class environment for AI-assisted software development.</p> <p data-start="667" data-end="1126">This is a highly hands-on role focused on technical leadership rather than people management. You should expect to spend most of your time prototyping, implementing, and validating AI-powered workflows while helping shape technical direction through hands-on engineering. You'll work at the intersection of developer tools, AI agents, IDE architecture, and product strategy while helping define how software developers work with AI in the future.</p> <h3><strong>Example problems you'll work on:</strong></h3> <ul data-start="1257" data-end="1772"> <li data-section-id="1kr8jn4" data-start="1257" data-end="1341">How can coding agents become more effective when working with large C++ codebases?</li> <li data-section-id="1grdqsk" data-start="1342" data-end="1472">How can CLion's debugging, code understanding, and navigation capabilities be integrated into AI-assisted development workflows?</li> <li data-section-id="1a96z5j" data-start="1473" data-end="1584">How should AI-powered developer experiences be evaluated and benchmarked in real-world development scenarios?</li> <li data-section-id="x2tg27" data-start="1585" data-end="1657">What capabilities should AI agents have access to inside a modern IDE?</li> <li data-section-id="1h33vb4" data-start="1658" data-end="1772">How can we make CLion a better environment for developers who increasingly collaborate with AI tools and agents?</li> </ul> <h3><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></h3> <ul> <li data-section-id="ulv941" data-start="167" data-end="285">Shape and deliver AI-powered features for CLion and C++ development workflows.</li> <li data-section-id="lhgmb6" data-start="286" data-end="417">Design the architecture for AI integrations, agent tools, and C++-specific AI capabilities.</li> <li data-section-id="dripig" data-start="418" data-end="591">Build practical benchmarks and evaluation frameworks for AI-assisted C++ development scenarios.</li> <li data-section-id="1gmdjb8" data-start="592" data-end="750">Prototype and validate new AI workflows, including debugging, code understanding, refactoring, and project navigation.</li> <li data-section-id="1qfb96v" data-start="751" data-end="923">Collaborate with product managers, ML engineers, QA engineers, stakeholders, and senior developers to shape and deliver the roadmap.</li> <li data-section-id="cg7clz" data-start="924" data-end="1109">Work closely with JetBrains AI, ML, and product teams to help define the AI strategy for the C++ ecosystem.</li> <li data-section-id="1ew61mo" data-start="1110" data-end="1273">Evaluate and prioritize AI initiatives, bringing new ideas and proposals that align with the broader JetBrains AI strategy.</li> <li data-section-id="mf99vh" data-start="1274" data-end="1465">Contribute hands-on to technical design, software architecture, and implementation in a large, mature codebase.</li> <li data-section-id="1j853ei" data-start="1466" data-end="1604">Help define a technical roadmap for AI agent and tool integrations in C++ development workflows.</li> <li data-section-id="10l7mut" data-start="1605" data-end="1737">Build trust and alignment across the C++ Ecosystem, AI, Product, QA, and ML organizations</li> </ul> <h3><strong>We'd love to talk if you have:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Significant software engineering experience as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Technical Lead, or similar senior technical role.</li> <li>Strong experience with Kotlin, Java, or other JVM technologies, or the ability to quickly become productive in a JVM-based codebase.</li> <li>Experience building AI-powered products, developer tools, coding assistants, agents, or LLM-based workflows.</li> <li data-section-id="u914ku" data-start="4530" data-end="4665">Strong understanding of how modern coding agents operate, including tool calling, context management, MCP, and evaluation techniques.</li> <li data-section-id="878m62" data-start="4755" data-end="4843">A track record of driving technical direction in ambiguous and rapidly evolving areas.</li> <li data-section-id="1lcrl1i" data-start="4844" data-end="4932">Strong product instincts and an ability to balance innovation with practical delivery.</li> <li data-section-id="vtnivs" data-start="4933" data-end="5020">Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence without formal authority.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to have</strong></h3> <ul data-start="1342" data-end="1687"> <li data-section-id="1b3ujlt" data-start="1342" data-end="1462">Experience with C++ development workflows, compilers, debuggers, language tooling, or developer productivity products.</li> <li data-section-id="p2q2va" data-start="1463" data-end="1569">Experience with IDE internals, language servers, code analysis, refactoring systems, or static analysis.</li> <li data-section-id="1axscea" data-start="1570" data-end="1633">Experience leading small teams or acting as a technical lead.</li> <li data-section-id="ny4zci" data-start="1634" data-end="1687">Experience working on AI-native developer products.</li> </ul> <h3 data-section-id="ctb2ez" data-start="4418" data-end="4445"><strong>Why this role is unique</strong></h3> <p title: Director, Customer Success, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3>Position overview</h3> <p>GitLab is looking for a strategic, commercially minded, and operationally rigorous Director of Customer Success to lead our EMEA Customer Success Management &amp; Architecture (CSMA) and Customer Success Engineering (CSE) organizations.</p> <p>This leader will own the regional customer-success operating model across relationship management, adoption architecture, technical enablement, customer health, and outcome realization. The role brings together the strengths of CSMA and CSE so customers can move from implementation to adoption, measurable business outcomes, expansion, and renewal with a consistent experience.</p> <p>You will lead through managers and senior leaders, build a high-performing all-remote organization, and partner closely with Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success Operations.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <h4>Set the regional customer-success strategy</h4> <ul> <li>Translate GitLab’s customer-outcomes strategy into a clear EMEA plan for CSMA and CSE.</li> <li>Define the regional engagement model, coverage strategy, segmentation, capacity model, and operating rhythm across dedicated, pooled, and scaled motions.</li> <li>Establish a single view of the customer journey, from onboarding and implementation through adoption, optimization, expansion, and renewal.</li> <li>Ensure the organization consistently connects GitLab adoption to customer-defined business outcomes—not activity, features, or meetings alone.</li> <li>Represent EMEA customer needs and patterns in global Customer Success strategy and planning.</li> </ul> <h4>Lead CSMA and CSE as one integrated organization</h4> <ul> <li>Build strong alignment between CSMA relationship leadership and CSE technical expertise, with clear roles, handoffs, decision rights, and escalation paths.</li> <li>Ensure every appropriate customer has a current success plan with measurable outcomes, milestones, owners, risks, and next actions.</li> <li>Create a consistent approach to adoption architecture, use-case progression, technical enablement, and value realization.</li> <li>Develop scalable programs—such as webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, adoption plays, and executive engagements—that increase customer reach and impact.</li> <li>Partner with Professional Services to create continuity from implementation through adoption, including high-quality handoffs and clear ownership after delivery.</li> <li>Ensure CSE capacity is focused on the moments that most improve adoption, time-to-value, customer health, and expansion readiness.</li> </ul> <h4>Drive adoption, outcomes, and GitLab platform value</h4> <ul> <li>Make product adoption and verified customer outcomes the centre of the operating model.</li> <li>Build the capabilities required to help customers adopt GitLab’s strategic use cases, including GitLab Duo and the Duo Agent Platform where relevant to customer objectives.</li> <li>Use product-usage data, customer feedback, success-plan progress, and health signals to identify risk and prioritize intervention.</li> <li>Establish repeatable plays to accelerate onboarding, remove adoption blockers, increase breadth and depth of use, and support customers in achieving measurable value.</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Renewal Management to turn adoption progress and outcome evidence into a credible expansion and renewal narrative.</li> </ul> <h4>Own operational excellence and business performance</h4> <ul> <li>Establish a disciplined cadence for forecasting, customer health, risk management, pipeline inspection, capacity planning, and performance reviews.</li> <li>Define a balanced scorecard for CSMA and CSE that includes customer outcomes, adoption, retention health, expansion influence, coverage, productivity, quality, and team development.</li> <li>Improve data quality and operational consistency across Gainsight, Salesforce, reporting dashboards, and other systems of record.</li> <li>Ensure customer escalations are handled with clear ownership, appropriate executive engagement, and timely cross-functional coordination.</li> <li>Identify systemic friction in the customer journey and lead continuous-improvement initiatives that scale across EMEA and globally.</li> </ul> <h4>Build and develop an exceptional team</h4> <ul> <li>Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing CSMA and CSE leaders and practitioners across EMEA.</li> <li>Set clear expectations for customer leadership, technical depth, commercial acumen, operational discipline, and collaboration.</li> <li>Create career paths, enablement plans, mentoring programs, and succession plans for both disciplines.</li> <li>Foster an inclusive, accountable, and high-trust culture consistent with GitLab’s values and all-remote ways of working.</li> <li>Use talent, capacity, and organizational design decisions to ensure the team can support a changing portfolio and evolving product strategy.</li> </ul> <h4>Partner across the revenue and product ecosystem</h4> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with regional Sales and Renewal Management leaders while maintaining clear accountability for CS-owned outcomes and signals.</li> <li>Partner with Professional Services on shared customer plans, implementation-to-adoption transitions, and services attach opportunities.</li> <li>Bring structured customer insight to Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing, and Enablement.</li> <li>Orchestrate executive engagement for strategic customers and high-severity risks.</li> <li>Collaborate with global Customer Success leaders to standardize what should scale and preserve the regional adaptations that improve customer impact.</li> </ul> <h3>What success looks like</h3> <ul> <li>Customers achieve measurable outcomes and progress through their intended GitLab use cases.</li> <li>CSMA and CSE operate as one coordinated team with clear ownership, effective handoffs, and a consistent customer experience.</li> <li>Adoption, customer health, renewal risk, and expansion signals are visible, accurate, and acted on early.</li> <li>GitLab’s strategic capabilities—including Duo and the Duo Agent Platform—are adopted in ways that align to customer priorities and measurable value.</li> <li>EMEA improves time-to-value, retention health, customer advocacy, and expansion influence.</li> <li>The organization has strong leadership depth, healthy talent pipelines, and a culture of accountability and continuous learning.</li> <li>Operating metrics Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR): Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions.

Ideals Board: Board and leadership collaboration platform for faster, safer, and more compliant decision-making.

The role

Ideals is uniquely positioned to redefine the VDR industry. Now we aim to own the upmarket M&A segment and establish Ideals as the Tier 1 brand in that space - translating market leadership into stronger brand equity, pipeline, and revenue. We're looking for a VP of Marketing to make this happen.

You'll lead a high-performing global team and shape the marketing function end-to-end: positioning and category authority, a scalable demand engine, and the operating system behind it. This is a builder's role for a strategic, data-driven leader who wants their work to show up in commercial results, not just in brand tracking.

This is a fully remote role for candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Switzerland, or the Netherlands.

 

What you will do

  • Define how Ideals wins
    You'll own positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, and GTM plans across every product, segment, and region – the strategic foundation everything else in marketing builds on.

  • Build category authority
    From industry events, reports, and benchmarks to media relations, executive visibility, and speaking programmes - you'll make Ideals the name the upmarket M&A segment thinks of first, and keep every external touchpoint aligned with our brand positioning.

As the Key Accounts Sales team scales, you'll direct regional programmes into each market's sales plan and own the result end to end against pipeline and revenue targets.

  • Run marketing as a system

  • Lead the people who make it happen

What you bring

What this looks like in practice:

  • Own front-end delivery on Prevail, our operational planning platform, from interaction design through production

  • Build interfaces for real geospatial problems: interactive maps, multiple data layers, large datasets, and time-sensitive workflows well beyond a typical CRUD application

  • Work with product and design early, turning operational needs into clear flows and production-ready experiences

  • Raise the front-end quality bar across the team by reviewing and improving work from engineers with different specialities, including AI-assisted code

  • Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed and durability, especially when a high-stakes demo or deployment creates a short deadline

  • Help create reusable patterns that make the product more coherent as the team and surface area grow

Who We're Looking For

We filter hardest on mission drive, low ego, attention to detail, and resilience under pressure. We want someone who cares about front-end engineering as a craft and can still move quickly when the problem is ambiguous.

Must-have:

  • Strong production experience with React and TypeScript, with front-end engineering as a core part of your craft

  • A track record of owning complex interfaces from problem definition through release and iteration

  • Strong product and design judgement: you notice weak hierarchy, inconsistent interactions, and confusing states before a specification points them out

  • Pragmatism and low ego: you can improve rough work from other engineers without turning every implementation choice into a philosophical debate

  • Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities, while keeping the quality of what ships high

  • EU or UK citizenship (contractual requirement tied to our defence contracts)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with mapping, cartographic, GIS, or other geospatial applications

  • Front-end performance work involving large or real-time datasets

  • Experience building offline-capable or resource-constrained web applications

  • Experience creating or scaling a design system

  • Prior work in defence, government, or dual-use technology

What's In It For You

  • A top 0.1% European compensation package, including base salary and equity

  • Paris or London based

  • Ownership of a product surface used in real operational environments

  • Direct collaboration with product design and engineering, with room to shape front-end standards as the team grows

The Process

  1. Talent screening: 30 min, online. We cover your background, motivations, and what you want to own next.

  2. Front-end interview: 60 min, online. We assess React and TypeScript fundamentals, product judgement, and how you reason through an unfamiliar interface problem.

  3. Onsite in Paris: half day. You see the product, present a project you are proud of, and work through a front-end design and re-engineering exercise based on a realistic product problem.

  4. Roundtable: hiring committee reviews the full set of evidence and makes the final decision.

title: Principal Thermo-Mechanical Engineer- Paris/Grenoble
description: About Us We are building Physics AI for hardware design . Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows. Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems. Role Overview As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team , you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value. As trusted technical advisors , you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs . Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market. Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics , you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems. You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel t o product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement. This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel , primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team . Responsibilities Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers , setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe. Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers. Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value. Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion , providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting. Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks , partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features. Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events , engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations. Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively. Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications) Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Asys, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software. Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems. Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships. Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data. Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams. Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives. Preferred (Desirable Differentiators) Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal solutions management and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows. Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises. Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments. Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools. Why Join Us Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected. Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.Ingénieur / Ingénieure principal/e en thermomécanique (H/F) — Paris/Grenoble À propos de Vinci Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants. C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes. Présentation du poste En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel. En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché. Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que le warpage, l'évolution des contraintes, le cyclage thermique et la fiabilité, sur des composants semi-conducteurs avancés, des packages électroniques et des systèmes à l'échelle du wafer. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d'usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d'interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme. Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l'équipe américaine. Responsabilités Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d'ingénieur/es en thermomécanique, en définissant l'orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l'équipe, et en pilotant l'exécution sur le terrain à travers l'Europe. Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations de produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels. Accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d'évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l'exécution de cas de test complexes et l'interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci. Piloter l'accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l'onboarding, le déploiement et l'expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes. Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés. Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d'événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme. Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci. Qualifications (Qualifications minimales) Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié. Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Ansys, Abaqus ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en simulation thermomécanique — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique. Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies. Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des équipes d'ingénierie côté client. Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des flux de travail ou analyser des données issues de simulations. Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l'exécution au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie. Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des publics techniques de haut niveau que pour des directions non spécialistes. Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants) Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance de la gestion thermique et des solutions de refroidissement et/ou des flux de travail Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI). Expérience commerciale : Expérience directe dans la commercialisation de logiciels techniques — idéalement des outils d'Electronic Design Automation (EDA) ou de simulation CAE — auprès de grandes entreprises des secteurs des semi-conducteurs et de l'électronique. Parcours Go-to-Market : Passage préalable par des fonctions de pré-vente technique, d'ingénierie applicative (FAE) ou de vente technique stratégique. Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des flux de travail de nouvelle génération fondés sur la physique, ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l'IA. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Ne vous contentez pas d'utiliser l'IA : rejoignez une équipe qui redéfinit activement la manière dont le silicium et les systèmes hardware de nouvelle génération sont conçus. Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d'IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux. Collaborez avec des équipes d'ingénierie et de recherche de renommée mondiale, dans un environnement de start-up en forte croissance. Lieu : Paris ou Grenoble, France Type d'emploi : Temps plein Mode de travail : Télétravail Département : Commercial Compensation: $110K – $140K • $110K – $140K Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

    Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

    C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes.

    Présentation du poste

    En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

    En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

    Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que le warpage, l'évolution des contraintes, le cyclage thermique et la fiabilité, sur des composants semi-conducteurs avancés, des packages électroniques et des systèmes à l'échelle du wafer.

    Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d'usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d'interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

    Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l'équipe américaine.

    Responsabilités

    • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d'ingénieur/es en thermomécanique, en définissant l'orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l'équipe, et en pilotant l'exécution sur le terrain à travers l'Europe.

    • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations de produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels.

    • Accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d'évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l'exécution de cas de test complexes et l'interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci.

    • Piloter l'accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l'onboarding, le déploiement et l'expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes.

    • Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés.

    • Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d'événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme.

    • Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci.

    Qualifications (Qualifications minimales)

    Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié.

    Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Ansys, Abaqus ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en simulation thermomécanique — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique.

    Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies.

    Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des équipes d'ingénierie côté client.

    Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des flux de travail ou analyser des données issues de simulations.

    Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l'exécution au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie.

    Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des publics techniques de haut niveau que pour des directions non spécialistes.

    Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants)

    Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance de la gestion thermique et des solutions de refroidissement et/ou des flux de travail Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI).

    Expérience commerciale : Expérience directe dans la commercialisation de logiciels techniques — idéalement des outils d'Electronic Design Automation (EDA) ou de simulation CAE — auprès de grandes entreprises des secteurs des semi-conducteurs et de l'électronique.

    Parcours Go-to-Market : Passage préalable par des fonctions de pré-vente technique, d'ingénierie applicative (FAE) ou de vente technique stratégique.

    Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des flux de travail de nouvelle génération fondés sur la physique, ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l'IA.

    Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

    • Ne vous contentez pas d'utiliser l'IA : rejoignez une équipe qui redéfinit activement la manière dont le silicium et les systèmes hardware de nouvelle génération sont conçus.

    • Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d'IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux.

description: Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure. Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants. Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Maîtriser la prospection, les séquences outbound, le premier contact et la prise de rendez-vous. Français langue maternelle (ou C1+), anglais courant (B2 minimum, pour travailler avec les équipes transverses). Drive et résilience : les objectifs ambitieux vous motivent et le "non" ne vous fait pas peur. Vous apprenez vite, vous posez les questions qui dérangent et vous allez chercher le feedback. Wellpass : abonnement sport & bien-être (cofinancé par l'employeur). Programme Erasmus : 1 semaine par an, vol et logement pris en charge, pour travailler depuis nos bureaux de Madrid, Barcelone, Milan, Rome, Berlin ou Sofia. Mise en situation : approche et résilience. Entretien final : valeurs et culture. Offre. Chez Lexroom , nous sommes portés par des ambitions fortes et une exigence d'excellence. Nous construisons quelque chose de grand, et cela demande de l'engagement, du travail et une vraie envie de progresser. Si ce défi vous parle, nous serons ravis de recevoir votre candidature. title: Post-doctorante ou post-doctorant en Informatique - CDD 12 Mois
description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) ! Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé. 🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions. 💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que post-doctorant(e), vous êtes au cœur des missions de recherche et d’innovation du Centre Ingénierie et Santé. Vous rejoignez l’équipe i4S pour développer les fondements scientifiques d’une nouvelle génération de jumeaux numériques populationnels (JNP) en santé, en lien étroit avec la société Dali. Le Centre Ingénierie et Santé développe des recherches à l’interface entre ingénierie, mathématiques, informatique et santé. Ses travaux associent modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle et sciences des données pour répondre à des problématiques cliniques, organisationnelles et populationnelles en collaboration avec des acteurs académiques, hospitaliers et industriels. Dali (Decision Aid · Live Innovation) est un bureau d’études innovant spécialisé dans la modélisation, la simulation et l’intelligence artificielle appliquées au système de santé. Son ambition est de transformer le système de soins grâce à une ingénierie de pointe basée sur des données : création de jumeaux numériques, modélisation prédictive, optimisation de parcours patients, modélisation de services hospitaliers et amélioration des performances des organisations de santé. Dali a été co-créée début 2025 par Martin PRODEL (PhD, 12 ans d’expérience en données de santé, ex-Heva) et Vincent Augusto (PhD, HDR, Pr, 20 d’expérience en ingénierie de la santé et recherche, Mines Saint-Etienne).  Objectif stratégique : préparer les briques scientifiques des JNP à horizon 3 à 5 ans, au-delà des premiers démonstrateurs industriels déjà engagés.   Le post-doctorat doit permettre de lever des verrous en modélisation dynamique de cohortes, génération de patients virtuels, apprentissage des transitions et simulation de scénarios contrefactuels.   Vos missions principales : Vous concevez et formalisez des modèles mathématiques et stochastiques de trajectoires de patients : chaînes de Markov, modèles multi-états, modèles d’état, processus de décision markoviens, simulation Monte-Carlo et approches hybrides. Vous développez en Python des prototypes de JNP capables d’apprendre leurs paramètres à partir de données réelles, de générer des trajectoires virtuelles et de tester des scénarios thérapeutiques ou de prise en charge. Vous proposez des méthodes de calibration, d’estimation, d’optimisation, de quantification de l’incertitude et de validation des modèles ; vous comparez les approches sur des cas d’usage issus de cohortes, registres ou données de vie réelle. Vous contribuez à la valorisation scientifique des travaux (publications, conférences, logiciels), à la formalisation des briques transférables vers DALI et vous rendez compte de l’avancement au responsable scientifique du projet.   Votre capacité à passer d’un problème scientifique à un modèle formel puis à une implémentation robuste sera essentielle. Le poste demande un goût prononcé pour les mathématiques appliquées, l’algorithmique, la programmation scientifique et la recherche interdisciplinaire. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes impérativement titulaire d’un : Doctorat (Bac + 8) en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, automatique, recherche opérationnelle, génie industriel, data science quantitative ou domaine proche. Profil scientifique recherché : Solide formation en probabilités, statistiques, processus stochastiques, optimisation, modélisation et simulation, et/ou systèmes dynamiques. Appétence pour le domaine de la santé. Compétences attendues : Maîtrise avancée de Python scientifique (NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn ou équivalents) et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel, versionnement et reproductibilité. Expérience significative d’au moins une famille de modèles dynamiques : Markov / MDP, modèles multi-états, Monte-Carlo, équations différentielles, modèles d’état ou simulation multi-agents / à événements discrets. Capacité à articuler modèles mathématiques et données : estimation de paramètres, calibration, analyse de sensibilité, validation, quantification de l’incertitude. Maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique écrit et oral (niveau B2 minimum, C1 apprécié) ; capacité à rédiger des articles et à présenter des travaux dans un contexte international. Vos atouts supplémentaires : Expérience sur données longitudinales, données de santé, cohortes, essais cliniques ou données de vie réelle. Connaissance d’un environnement de simulation (AnyLogic, SimPy, MATLAB/Simulink ou équivalent) et/ou d’un langage compilé (C++, Java). Expérience de publication dans des revues ou conférences en modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle, recherche opérationnelle ou santé numérique. 🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ? Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde . Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver : ·  Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain ·  Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an · Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail. Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science , l’ ingénierie , et des projets qui font sens . 📩 Candidatez dès maintenant ! Date limite de candidature : 15/10/2026 🔗 Les dossiers de candidature (CV, lettre de motivation, lettre de recommandation le cas échéant, pièce d’identité) sont à déposer sur la plateforme RECRUITEE  https://institutminestelecom.recruitee.com/o/post-doctorante-ou-post-doctorant-en-informatique-cdd-12-mois   Dans le cadre de sa politique Égalité, Diversité et Inclusion, l’École des Mines de Saint Etienne est un employeur soucieux de l’équité de traitement entre les candidatures.  Informations complémentaires ·  Date de prise de poste souhaitée : 01/01/2027 ·  Rémunération fixée selon le profil du candidat, en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l’Institut Mines Télécom. ·  Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap. ·   Emploi ouvert aux personnes contractuelles ·   A moyen terme un poste pérenne est susceptible d’être ouvert ·   Toute candidature peut faire l’objet d’une enquête administrative ·   A usage interne Institut Mines Télécom : Ø  Catégorie II – Métier P – Post-doctorant selon le Cadre de Gestion   Les candidats retenus après examen de leur dossier de candidature seront reçus en entretien le 28/10/2026  à Saint-Étienne. 📞 Contacts ·  Sur le contenu du poste : Vincent AUGUSTO – Professeur, directeur du CIS Mail : Tél. : +33 (0)4 77 42 66 26 · Sur les aspects administratifs/RH: Milica PETKOVIC– Gestionnaire RH Mail :    Tel. : + 33 (0)4 77 42 02 08  Liens utiles : Ecole : https://www.mines-stetienne.fr/ IMT : La protection de vos données : https://www.mines-stetienne.fr/wp-content/uploads/2018/12/Informations-des-candidats-sur-les-traitements-de-donn%C3%A9es-personnelles.pdf etienne.fr/wp-content/uploads/2018/12/Informations-des-candidats-sur-les-traitements-de-donn%C3%A9es-personnelles.pdf Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
